leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a constant object using as const to enforce type safety.
Apply the as const assertion to freeze object literals and their nested properties.
Implement a union type derived from an as const object's values.
Manipulate type inference by comparing mutable and as const object behaviors.
Configure a function parameter to accept only values from an as const union type.
Initialize a variable with a value from an as const object and validate its type.
Integrate an as const object into a type alias for reusable type definitions.
lessonTitle: Type safe enum like constants with as const
